=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- tests/test_apply_analysis_on_main.py:362-363 (`guard = source_run.find('!= "stable"', gate_exit)` and the `assert guard > gate_exit` immediately below it) | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The test was updated to accept the new `printf` form of the gate-only path write, but the release-path search still uses the old literal `!= "stable"`.
  WHY: The workflow now contains `if [ "${DISPATCH_REF}" != "refs/heads/stable" ]; then` (test-and-mark-stable.yml:183 and mark-stable.yml:53), so `source_run.find('!= "stable"', gate_exit)` returns -1. `guard > gate_exit` is `assert -1 > 484`, raising `AssertionError: release path must check the dispatch ref against 'stable'`. The CI run 37828358634 confirms this is the current `tests-promote-stall-and-review` failure that propagates to the aggregate `lint` check and blocks the PR. The fix is to search for the new string, e.g. `source_run.find('!= "refs/heads/stable"', gate_exit)`; the test's intent (find the stable-ref guard after the gate-only path's `exit 0`) is otherwise sound.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR should account for all issues it resolves — at minimum its title/body must enumerate the issues that the diff actually closes, otherwise reviewers and consumers cannot trace each finding to its fix.
  Expected change site: PR title and description (top of the PR).
  Evidence of absence: The PR body reads "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6546" and the title reads "AI implementation for issue #6546". The diff, however, ships one fragment and one substantive fix per issue in {6525, 6531, 6533, 6539, 6541, 6546, 6755, 6777}: implement automation-path grant guard (6525), release diagnostic no credential dump (6531), api-write-guard worker-scope (6533), security-pass keep-fixing cap fails (6539), unblock judge no security waiver (6541), release-ref exact match (6546), merged-PR guard shell wrappers (6755) and nested-heredoc wrapper check (6777). `Refs #<n>` lines for those issues are absent from the PR body. Issue #6546 alone does not explain any of those seven additional scopes of work, so the description is materially incomplete.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
